invariants.rationale: The method is expected to always return a HoodieWriteMetadata object.
It is likely that the caller is expected to provide a valid (non-null) list of records.
instantTime is likely a required parameter indicating the commit instant, so it should not be null or empty.
The returned write metadata should always contain a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
The size of the WriteStatus list should not be negative and reflects the outcome of the upsert operation.
